run_deepthink_online: run DeepThinkLLM in online mode to process a single question from a JSONL dataset
prepare_prompt_deepseek: prepare a chat template prompt for a DeepSeek model using the tokenizer and question
prepare_prompt_gpt: prepare a chat template prompt for a GPT model with configurable reasoning effort
evaluate_voting_results: evaluate voting results against ground truth and return correctness with confidence scores
evaluate_confidence_methods: evaluate confidence-based methods including warmup traces and early stopped traces accuracy
